predictedBugs: A failed import could leave a created contact behind; live execution now uses one RPC and memory execution snapshots contact, rich-contact, activity, external-link and receipt state.
Archived or shared identity signals could create duplicates; preview now returns archived-match or ambiguous-identity and performs no mutation.
The Node TypeScript CLI could fail on extensionless or tsconfig-alias imports; its transitive memory repository imports now use explicit relative .ts paths.
edgeCases: Restoring a contact point cannot violate the per-type count, duplicate-normalization or primary-point invariants.
Assignments to revoked or other-workspace memberships and relationships across workspaces fail closed.
Import replay returns a no-op receipt while a conflicting payload under the same group key is rejected.

limitations: CodeRabbit is unavailable because the configured WSL environment has no bash; no automated review PASS is claimed.
Browser, 390px, theme, keyboard and screen-reader QA were not run because permission to control the browser was not granted.
Live CLI authentication was verified fail-closed without credentials; hosted Supabase and real-account UAT were not performed.
